contradicted.claim: OVD-598 description: requested_by_date and applicable_vendors edits between validation and lane/permit creation go undetected because they are not part of the scope fingerprint
contradicted.actual: Partly wrong. Any edit to approved_part_requirements fires a touch trigger that bumps updated_at, and the hashed lane scope snapshot includes requirement.updated_at as 'capturedAt'. So a requirement edit committed before the lane is built changes the fingerprint and the request fails closed (xometry_beta_scope_changed or xometry_beta_created_lane_mismatch). What is truly unbound is jobs.requested_service_kinds, which is not in the snapshot; the impl re-check only requires that the list contains manufacturing_quote or sourcing_only. job_files.file_kind/job_id/organization_id are also not in the snapshot. On every field, a concurrent edit is never made to wait, so the 'edit during issuance waits' acceptance criterion is unmet across the board.
contradicted.evidence: Trigger touch_approved_part_requirements_updated_at (20260303101500:344-347). build_quote_lane_scope_snapshot 'capturedAt', requirement.updated_at (20260926225000:378-420). quote_scope_fingerprint = sha256(snapshot::text) (20260812041000:281). The api_request_xometry_beta_dispatch lane check compares v_lane.scope_fingerprint with p_expected_scope_fingerprint. The impl's service-kind check is at 20260812044000 impl lines 54-66.
